messages.subject: Momentum Threshold Model
parts:
Hello Everyone,

I am doing a master's thesis on a momentum threshold model that relates country risk rating to stock market index. I have some questions about using the tdsyn package for this.

1) I need to perform a basic OLS and use the residuals for the MTAR model. Do I input the only the residuals in the data input to TVECM or should I input all the data?
2)I am getting some errors while executing the command

tv<-TVECM(egypt_resid, nthresh=1,lag=1, ngridBeta=20, ngridTh=20, plot=TRUE,trim=0.05, common="All")
Error in y[, 2] : subscript out of bounds

 To give you an idea about the data

str(egypt_resid)
'data.frame':   33 obs. of  1 variable:
 $ V1: num  NA -1.273 -0.956 -1.112 -0.724 ..

Any help will be appreciated.

Regards,
Prarthana

messages.subject: [tsDyn] Momentum Threshold Model
parts:
Hi Prarthana

Sorry for late reply, in, holiday...

So you have basically two ways to approach this:
-univariate: you estimate yourself the relationship, extract the residuals and feed them into setar(). This is the approach advocated initially by Enders and granger
-multivariate: you just give a data frame with the two series into tvecm()

Estimating a full tvecm will give you in addition how the adjustment coefficients are different in the regimes. Now if you want to investigate a Matt, you can do this only with the setar() function, although I am not sure what is the interpretation you want to give to your coefficients? Maybe if you write down the equations, it will be clearer what you are looking for?

Best

Matthieu
